title: Bridging the Modality Gap in Long-Form Clinical Audio: A Comparative Study of Lightweight and Heavyweight End-to-End SOAP Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.14467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automating clinical documentation from long-form doctor-patient conversations remains challenging for modern audio-language models. While cascaded ASR systems perform well, end-to-end (E2E) models often struggle with information loss and hallucinations on extended audio. For the BeTraC 2026 challenge, the ASLP team presents a fully E2E multimodal system that generates structured SOAP notes directly from audio, bypassing intermediate transcripts. We constructed a 1.41-million-sample multi-task corpus and applied a multi-stage pipeline: domain pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reward optimization. Evaluating the architecture under both Lightweight (3B) and Heavyweight (30B) constraints reveals that each training stage progressively enhances performance. translated_title: 弥合长时临床音频中的模态鸿沟：轻量级与重量级端到端SOAP生成系统的比较研究
translated_abstract: 从长时医患对话中自动化生成临床文档对现代音频-语言模型而言仍是一项挑战。尽管级联ASR系统表现良好，但端到端（E2E）模型在处理长音频时常常面临信息丢失和幻觉问题。在BeTraC 2026挑战赛中，ASLP团队提出了一个完全端到端的多模态系统，可直接从音频生成结构化的SOAP病历，无需中间转录文本。我们构建了一个包含141万样本的多任务语料库，并应用了多阶段训练流水线：领域预训练、监督微调和奖励优化。在轻量级（3B）和重量级（30B）两种约束下对架构进行评估，结果表明每个训练阶段均能逐步提升性能。此外，将模型扩展至300亿参数可显著提升概念提取和摘要质量。最终，我们的端到端系统始终优于代表性的级联系统。
tldr: ASLP团队提出完全端到端多模态系统，通过141万样本多任务语料库和多阶段训练（领域预训练、监督微调、奖励优化），直接从长时医患对话音频生成结构化SOAP病历，在3B和30B两种规模下均超越了级联ASR系统的表现。
en_tdlr: The ASLP team presents a fully end-to-end multimodal system that generates structured SOAP notes directly from long-form clinical audio using a 1.41-million-sample multi-task corpus and multi-stage training (domain pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reward optimization), consistently outperforming cascaded ASR systems at both 3B and 30B scales.
